finding: The M4/16GB machine and 12GB project cap support processed CRISPR matrices and source-paired API analysis, but not raw sequencing or whole-slide workflows.
All eight predeclared genes had 177 paired Broad/Sanger models; median gene-wise Spearman rho was 0.4222 and all correlations were positive.
The harmonized fc_clean_qn field is adequate for an engineering gate but not an untouched independent-replication endpoint.

Before WRN outcome access, the historical eligible colorectal cohort contained Broad 7 MSI/12 MSS, Sanger 10 MSI/19 MSS, and shared 6 MSI/7 MSS models; Broad failed the independent critic's proposed 8-per-class adequacy gate.
The preregistered processing-inflation hypothesis failed: median rho(fc_clean_qn)-rho(bf_scaled) was -0.0031 and only 4/8 genes favored fc_clean_qn, despite identical 177-model cohorts.

DepMap 26Q1 ScreenGeneEffect is explicitly library-corrected and is not a source-independent endpoint; 23Q4 source-separated naive scores are provenance-appropriate, but CRC-only Avana remains inadequate at 7 MSI models.

Broad Avana recovered the known MSI-WRN association across four tissues with stratified delta -0.7432, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.9377,-0.5019], permutation p=1/100001, and all four tissue effects negative.
Held-out Sanger KY confirmed the MSI-WRN association with stratified delta -0.9307, 95% bootstrap CI [-1.0000,-0.8133], permutation p=1/100001, and all four tissue effects negative.

Correction to the prior wording: KY is a sequentially gated confirmation contrast, not pristine unseen held-out values, because the first implementation parsed KY endpoints before the Avana gate. Numerical results and frozen gates were unchanged.

The four-tissue model-ordering design failed before outcome access: Endometrium had 5 overlapping Avana/KY models versus the independently frozen minimum of 8; no cross-source rank statistic was computed.
The preregistered two-tissue derived analysis passed: equal-tissue WRN rank agreement theta=0.5956, permutation p=13/100001, and paired-bootstrap 95% CI [0.2636,0.8114].
Ordering reliability was heterogeneous: Large Intestine rho=0.8211 versus Ovary rho=0.3701.
10/34 paired models had absolute source-percentile gaps >=0.25; A2780 was the largest gap at 0.7448, making technical-versus-biological discordance the next target.
Audit corrected the bootstrap to retain frozen full-denominator percentiles without reranking duplicates; compliant 95% CI is [0.3186,0.7870], and the scientific pass is unchanged.

The preregistered five-metric source-QC-rank-asymmetry hypothesis failed: equal-tissue association with WRN percentile gap theta=-0.0662, one-sided permutation p=0.6452, and fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.3922,0.2780].
Tissue directions disagreed (Large Intestine rho=-0.2549; Ovary rho=0.1225), so broad screen-QC asymmetry does not provide a useful positive explanation of WRN ranking gaps in this frozen set.
All 34 paired models had zero annotated mutations across all four eligible Avana and five eligible KY WRN guide locations; source-asymmetry exposure was constant zero in both tissues.
The guide-site mutation candidate failed before outcome access; no WRN-gap association was computed, ruling out only variation in this specific official binary exposure for the frozen cohort.
The preregistered common-essential model-general discordance hypothesis failed: theta=0.1147, p=0.2614, fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.2422,0.4396], with weak positive estimates in both tissues.
The separately frozen nonessential corroborative panel also failed and pointed slightly negative: theta=-0.1078, p=0.7272, CI [-0.4717,0.2683].

Across 1,227 common-essential and 618 nonessential controls, broad model-level cross-source discordance summaries did not explain the frozen WRN rank gaps; gene-specific and kinetic mechanisms remain open.
The preregistered sequence-inclusion-asymmetry hypothesis failed all primary gates: theta=0.0667, p=0.3542, fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.2377,0.3391].
Tissue directions were heterogeneous: Large Intestine rho=-0.3679 and Ovary rho=0.5014; neither was used as a post hoc subgroup rescue.
The near-duplicate passing-sequence sensitivity exposure produced theta=0.0710 and the same failed conclusion; simple sequence-count asymmetry did not consistently explain WRN source gaps.
The frozen included-sequence guide-LFC reconstruction reproduced 100/103 official WRN screen scores but failed three, with maximum absolute discrepancy 0.575461 versus tolerance 1e-8.

All three reconstruction failures were exactly the records where nIncludedSequences exceeded nPassingSequences and one included row had PassesQC=False; this exposes a pipeline-semantics ambiguity but does not verify an alternative rule.
The preregistered no-drift gate stopped execution before gap parsing and before all nine guide omissions, so single-guide robustness remains unresolved and no rescue filter was tried.

The sole post-failure passing-sequence reconstruction matched 103/103 frozen official WRN screen scores within 1e-8; maximum absolute discrepancy was 5.551115123125783e-17, all three EXP-010 mismatch identities resolved, and no new mismatch appeared.

This result verifies only the passing-and-nonexcluded sequence aggregation rule for the frozen 103-screen WRN subset; it does not repair EXP-010, establish whole-release semantics, or answer single-guide robustness.

The passing-sequence baseline reproduced all 103 official WRN scores and all 34 frozen EXP-005 gaps before any omission; the nine global single-guide perturbations were therefore executed under the preregistered baseline.

Only 5/10 baseline-flagged cross-source WRN gaps remained flagged under every one of four Avana and five KY omissions, failing the preregistered >=8/10 robustness criterion; six were robust to all Avana omissions and six to all KY omissions.

The deterministic stress test produced 26 unflagged-to-flagged transitions across 216 possible events involving 10 unique models, with no p-values, confidence intervals, guide-quality causal analysis, or clinical interpretation computed.

The preregistered source-relative Chronos efficacy discordance association failed: equal-tissue theta=0.2071078431, one-sided permutation p=0.1220187798, and fixed-rank bootstrap 95% CI [-0.1697118656,0.5334215543]. Only the tissue-rho floor gate passed.

The final adequacy gate used one observation per paired ModelID: 17 distinct efficacy and growth exposures per tissue, largest tie 1. Growth was descriptive only, with theta=0.1139705882 and no p-value or confidence interval.

This is a frozen two-tissue same-assay association failure after an already-unsealed EXP-005 endpoint; it does not establish causality, mechanism, therapeutic relevance, patient benefit, or clinical utility.

The known matrix-defined STAG2-status to STAG1-dependency direction was strongly negative in both source-specific cohorts: Avana delta=-0.4709, p=0.0000800, CI [-0.6151,-0.3056]; KY delta=-0.6413, p=0.0013500, CI [-0.7668,-0.4798].

Pre-outcome design sensitivity was only 0.5070 Avana and 0.2406 KY for the frozen delta=-0.20 target, below the 0.80 confirmatory threshold; Avana also failed the lineage-consistency gate due to Liver delta=+0.9130. The result is FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

The descriptive PDS5B-status to PDS5A result passed nominal Avana gates but failed KY permutation and lineage-consistency gates; it cannot rescue the primary and no secondary confirmatory claim is made.

The outcome-free design receipt supports feasibility-only analysis: realized seeded power was 0.8642 Avana and 0.5787 KY, with KY below the frozen 0.80 threshold; the primary confirmatory Boolean is permanently false.

Avana reproduced the predeclared ARID1A-status to ARID1B-dependency direction nominally: delta=-0.4582887701, permutation p=0.0000100000, bootstrap CI [-0.5967914439,-0.3122994652], all six nominal gates passed.

KY did not pass the frozen nominal robustness gates: delta=-0.2158693116 and p=0.0263397366, but bootstrap upper bound=0.0058343057 was not below zero and lineage deltas Bone=+1.0 and Pancreas=+0.2666666667 exceeded +0.20; no subgroup rescue or pooling was used.

The executable design receipt did not exactly reproduce the frozen candidate-census planning draw: Avana power=0.8652 versus 0.8622 and KY power=0.5875 versus 0.5699. The complete record is protocol-deviation/non-confirmatory only; the frozen preregistration was not rewritten.

Avana did not reproduce the ARID1A-status to KEAP1 dependency direction under the executable feasibility analysis: delta=-0.0545454545, p=0.2320476795, and bootstrap 95% CI [-0.1791443850,0.0695187166].

KY was directionally negative for ARID1A-status to KEAP1 dependency (delta=-0.2275379230, p=0.0207097929, CI [-0.4095682614,-0.0431738623]) but failed lineage consistency in Bone, CNS/Brain, and Lymphoid; no source passed all nominal gates and no confirmatory claim is allowed.

The frozen outcome-free design had planning power 0.9941 in Avana and 0.7521 in KY; the KY value is below the 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the experiment remains FEASIBILITY_ONLY with confirmatory_claim=false.

Avana showed a strong negative TP53-matrix-intact to MDM2 dependency association (delta=-0.6240834452, p=0.0000099999, CI [-0.7013373954,-0.5443560880]) but failed the lineage-consistency gate because Cervix=+0.3928571429 and Prostate=+0.3333333333.

KY showed a strong negative TP53-matrix-intact to MDM2 dependency association (delta=-0.5397973951, p=0.0000099999, CI [-0.6917510854,-0.3806078148]) and passed all six nominal gates; the permitted evidence tier remains T1 descriptive association only, not T2/confirmatory.

The outcome-free CDKN2A-damaging to TYMS design had Avana planning power 0.8954 and KY planning power 0.5364; KY is below the frozen 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the executable claim is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

Avana was directionally negative (delta=-0.1345336840, p=0.0277497225, CI [-0.2603783128,-0.0062714950]) but failed the delta<=-0.20 and no-positive-lineage gates, including Bowel=+0.6136363636, Eye=+0.5555555556, and Ampulla of Vater=+1.0.

KY was directionally negative but uncertain (delta=-0.1802884615, p=0.0624193758, CI [-0.3701923077,0.0120793269]) and failed effect, permutation, bootstrap, and lineage gates; the result is T1 descriptive association only, not T2/confirmatory.

The outcome-free PTEN-damaging to PIK3CB design had Avana planning power 0.8562 and KY planning power 0.5375; KY is below the frozen 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the executable claim is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

Avana showed a negative PTEN-damaging to PIK3CB association (delta=-0.2803388986, p=0.0001199988, CI [-0.3954647396,-0.1572389733]) but failed lineage consistency with Bowel=+0.4728682171, Cervix=+1.0, and Uterus=+0.2946428571.

KY was essentially null for PTEN-damaging to PIK3CB dependency (delta=-0.0066050198, p=0.4830751692, CI [-0.2153236460,0.2021136063]) and failed effect-size, permutation, bootstrap, and lineage gates; the result is T1 descriptive association only, not T2/confirmatory.

The outcome-free TP53-damaging to WEE1 design had Avana planning power 0.9948 and KY planning power 0.7564; KY is below the frozen 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the executable claim is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

Avana was near zero for damaging-matrix TP53 to WEE1 dependency (delta=-0.0385211195, p=0.2119178808, CI [-0.1279665393,0.0538108024]) and failed effect, permutation, bootstrap, and no-positive-lineage gates; no TP53 functional or causal claim is supported.

KY was strongly negative in aggregate (delta=-0.3096960926, p=0.0001799982, CI [-0.4703690304,-0.1461649783]) but failed the no-positive-lineage gate with Peripheral Nervous System=+0.4333333333 and Prostate=+1.0; no pooling or lineage rescue was used.

The outcome-free NF1-damaging to PTPN11 design had Avana planning power 0.7173 and KY planning power 0.4028; both are below the frozen 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the executable claim is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

Avana was negative for damaging-matrix NF1 to PTPN11 dependency (delta=-0.2493629414, p=0.0033399666, CI [-0.3797051329,-0.1132144157]) but failed lineage consistency with Bladder/Urinary Tract=+1.0 and Esophagus/Stomach=+0.5256410256.

KY was near zero for NF1-damaging to PTPN11 dependency (delta=+0.0461538462, p=0.6307336927, CI [-0.1615384615,0.2615384615]) and failed all substantive gates; no pooling, lineage rescue, functional-NF1, RAS-causal, inhibitor, treatment, or clinical claim is allowed.

The outcome-free EP300-damaging to CREBBP design had Avana planning power 0.7401 and KY planning power 0.4984; both are below the frozen 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the executable claim is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

Avana showed a strong negative EP300-damaging to CREBBP association (delta=-0.4171511628, p=0.0000099999, CI [-0.5566860465,-0.2609011628]) but failed lineage consistency with CNS/Brain=+0.3333333333 and Pancreas=+0.4.

KY showed a strong negative aggregate EP300-damaging to CREBBP association (delta=-0.4767932489, p=0.0000499995, CI [-0.6708860759,-0.2686357243]) but failed lineage consistency with Lymphoid=+0.7777777778, Ovary/Fallopian Tube=+0.44, Prostate=+1.0, and Skin=+0.3333333333; no pooling or rescue is allowed.

The outcome-free APC-damaging to TDO2 design had Avana planning power 0.5184 and KY planning power 0.2861; both are below the frozen 0.80 confirmatory threshold, so the executable claim is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY.

Avana was weakly negative for damaging-matrix APC to TDO2 dependency (delta=-0.1231788079, p=0.1548284517, CI [-0.2848013245,0.0331125828]) and failed effect-size, permutation, bootstrap, and lineage gates; no cross-source replication is supported.

KY was strongly positive rather than negative for APC-damaging to TDO2 dependency (delta=+0.4921630094, p=0.9965100349, CI [0.2476489028,0.7053291536]) and failed every substantive gate; the Avana/KY direction discordance is preserved without pooling or rescue.

The outcome-free KMT2D-damaging to KMT2C design had Avana planning power 0.8433 but KY planning power 0.5120; the paired experiment is permanently FEASIBILITY_ONLY and cannot support a confirmatory claim.

Avana showed a negative KMT2D-damaging to KMT2C association (delta=-0.1779171895, p=0.0097799022, CI [-0.3259723965,-0.0248431620]) but missed the preregistered effect threshold and failed lineage consistency; no pan-cancer dependency claim is supported.

KY was positive and uncertain rather than negative (delta=+0.1004016064, p=0.7971520285, CI [-0.1433065596,0.3413654618]); the Avana/KY discordance and positive-lineage heterogeneity are preserved without pooling or rescue.
